limitations: This is a scoped selection, not an exhaustive novelty review.
Published gains have not been reproduced locally and do not establish benefit in experiment1.
Dataset names alone do not establish identical preprocessing, candidates, collisions, or metric units.
A session-conditioned representation and a session-conditioned target identifier are different interventions.
No per-request full-catalogue re-encoding or unconstrained dynamic SID serving has been implemented.
